ramp.explanation: Daily rate starts at 30/day (the measured channel-wide 28-day rate) and grows 31.2% a month to 780/day by 2027-09-28; the area under it is exactly the 84,000 gap. The straight line needs 230.1/day every day.

this_month.closes_with: At the 7-day rate the channel reaches 18,224 by 2026-11-30, 313 short of 18,537. That is 9 long-forms at the demonstrated median (3,903 views x 9.1/1k = 36 subs each), or 0.22 of a breakout at the median (1,393 subs), or 22.4 more subs a day from community posts.

plans.label: Moments + exposure lane
plans.description: Built from the 2026-09-28 script autopsy. Long-form stays in the exposure lane at levels already hit (Two Brahmins and Mill: about 15,000 views at Chakla-class conversion), cadence rises to six a month; Shorts move to complete 96-134 second stories; community posts are run on purpose at a sustained rate; and breakouts timed to releases and anniversaries (moments radar) carry whatever is left. The breakouts figure is the number to plan the release calendar around.

notes: YouTube rounds the public subscriber count to three significant figures, so the actual line moves in steps of 100.

Plans attribute each upload's lifetime subscribers to its publish month; lever tracking measures subscribers earned in the window by videos under 90 days old. Most of a video's subscribers arrive in its first 90 days, so the two agree closely.
Breakouts are excluded from the long-form and Shorts medians so the typical video is priced without them; they are their own lever.
Community and channel-page subscribers come from channel_totals_by_type and are invisible to every uploads-filtered table.
Edit config/goal.json to change the plan. Values written as dem:<key> track the channel's demonstrated numbers automatically.
